text_raw: This is a disconnection notice from your electric company. Please contact the number on your bill if you have questions about your account.
Your phone service is scheduled for maintenance this evening. If you need more information, call the customer service line on your statement.
If you would like to keep coverage or extend it, press 8 to speak with a customer service agent and review your options.
We are calling to confirm your appointment for tomorrow morning. Please call our scheduling desk if you need to reschedule.
This is a reminder that your prescription is ready for pickup before the pharmacy closes today.
Press 2 if you want to be removed from our marketing list and stop receiving future offers.
The delivery for your package is scheduled for this afternoon. Please call the local branch if the time does not work for you.
To speak with a live agent about your order status, press 1 and stay on the line.
This is a courtesy reminder that your insurance renewal is due next week. Please review the notice online or call us.
Your account review is complete. Please call the number on your account statement if you need a copy of the final report.
We are contacting you about a local survey. Press 1 to confirm your participation or press 2 to opt out.
This call is to inform you that your appointment is confirmed for Friday at 3 pm. Please arrive ten minutes early.
If you have not received your package, call the shipping desk before the close of business today.
We are calling about your current service plan. Please review the updates online or speak with an agent if you have questions.
This is a billing reminder. Your payment is due by the end of the week and we will accept it online or by phone.
You have a voicemail waiting for you from your clinic. Please return the call before 5 pm to confirm the visit.
Customer service is calling to let you know your document is ready for pickup. Please come before closing time.
To verify your enrollment, press 1 and a representative will confirm the appointment details.
This is an automated message about your utility account. Please call the number listed on your bill if you need help.
Our system indicates your credit card was updated successfully. Call us if you need a copy of the confirmation email.
Press 1 to hear the latest update on your claim status or press 2 to hear the menu again.
We are following up on your service request. Please reply or call us before noon if you want an update.
Your bank account has been updated. Please call customer support if you need help setting up your new PIN.
This is a notice that your internet service will be restored after maintenance. Please review the schedule online.
To verify your address, press 1 and speak with an agent. We will not ask for sensitive information by email.
This is a reminder to return your library books before the end of the month to avoid a late fee.
We are calling to confirm your delivery window. Please let us know if you need to change the time before tomorrow.
Press 8 if you want to speak to a representative about renewal options for your subscription.
This is a courtesy call from the hospital to remind you about your lab test tomorrow morning.
Please call your provider before 4 pm if you need to reschedule your follow up appointment.
This is an official notice from your water utility. We are available to answer questions during business hours.
If you have any questions about your recent purchase, press 1 to speak with a customer care agent.
Your order has shipped and will arrive on Friday. Please contact customer support if you need to change the delivery address.
This call is to remind you that your annual service check is due this week. Please schedule the appointment online.
Before 5 pm today, please call the clinic if you need to update your treatment plan.
To learn more about the offer, press 1 and a representative will walk you through the details.
This is a reminder from your dental office. Please arrive ten minutes early for your cleaning appointment.
You are receiving this automated call because your prescription refill was processed successfully.
If you would like to speak to a service agent about your account, press 1 and we will connect you.
Your medical records are ready for pickup. Please bring identification and arrive before the office closes.
We are calling to let you know your final balance is due today. Please visit our website or call the billing office.
Please press 2 if you are not interested in additional information about your account status.
This is an automated message from the DMV. Please call the office if you need to reschedule your driving test.
To update your contact information, press 1 and follow the prompts to finish the verification.
Your insurance benefits summary is ready. Please review it online or call us by end of day if you have questions.
The pharmacy is calling to remind you that your medication refill is due tomorrow. Please call before 6 pm if you need assistance.
This is a reminder to complete your annual membership renewal before the deadline expires.
To discuss your service request with a representative, press 1 and we will connect you promptly.
We are calling about a required maintenance visit for your home security system. Please call the office before Friday.
This call is about your recent appointment and the follow-up instructions you were sent by email. Please contact us if needed.
